label: Kimi Code (native)
description: Moonshot's current native Kimi Code CLI binary (~/.kimi-code/bin/kimi), distinct from the legacy uv-tool kimi-cli package driven by the existing 'kimi-code' backend.

permissions.headless_auto_approve_justification: Empirically verified against the real `kimi` binary (v0.35.0 on 2026-08-12) that `--auto` and `--yolo` both hard-error when combined with `-p`/`--prompt` ("Cannot combine --prompt with --auto." / "...--yolo."). Plain `kimi -p "..."` with no approval flag already auto-approves ordinary tool calls, so no approval flag is passed or valid for headless dispatch on this backend.
